# `Q-2-34` — Unquoted Shortcode Parameter Starting with Digit

> A shortcode parameter value that starts with a digit must be
> quoted.

## What this means

Shortcode parameter parsing uses leading-digit as a hint about
whether a value is a number or a string. Values that begin with
a digit but contain non-numeric characters are ambiguous, so
Quarto requires them to be quoted explicitly.

## Why this happens

A version string, an identifier, or a mixed-format token that
starts with a digit:

```{.markdown shortcodes="false"}
{{< a k=1b >}}
```

`1b` is neither a clean number nor an obvious string — Quarto
asks the author to disambiguate.

## How to fix

Wrap the value in double quotes:

```{.markdown shortcodes="false"}
{{< a k="1b" >}}
```

## Example

```{.markdown shortcodes="false"}
{{< a k=1b >}}
```
